teaser: Four in the morning and you are still awake, scrolling for the next possibility instead of sleeping on the last one. Life path 9 asks for letting go; ESTP moves toward the next opening before anyone else has spotted it. In you, those two instincts share a room and argue about the furniture. The 9 wants release — of a grudge, a plan, a person who no longer needs you. The ESTP in you releases almost everything quickly and without ceremony, the way a hand opens after catching a ball. The question is which 9 asks you to release, and whether you noticed you were holding it at all.
excerpt: The porch with paint peeling along the rail is where the conversation happens, you standing with one foot already off the step, your partner waiting for a plan to stay put for once.
